gloss: to wash away, to sweep away

definitions.gloss: to wash away, to sweep away
definitions.explanation: For water, flood, or other force to carry something away by pushing.
Figuratively, to overwhelm something with force, to brush aside or disregard.

examples.japanese: {洪水|こうずい}で{橋|はし}が{押|お}し{流|なが}された。
examples.english: The bridge was washed away by the flood.

examples.japanese: {津波|つなみ}が{家|いえ}を{押|お}し{流|なが}した。
examples.english: The tsunami swept away the houses.

examples.japanese: {激流|げきりゅう}に{押|お}し{流|なが}されないように{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful not to be swept away by the rapids.

examples.japanese: {反対|はんたい}{意見|いけん}を{押|お}し{流|なが}して{強行|きょうこう}した。
examples.english: They pushed through despite opposition, sweeping aside objections.

examples.japanese: {多数派|たすうは}の{意見|いけん}が{少数派|しょうすうは}の{声|こえ}を{押|お}し{流|なが}した。
examples.english: The majority opinion swept aside the minority's voice.

examples.japanese: {時代|じだい}の{流|なが}れが{古|ふる}い{価値観|かちかん}を{押|お}し{流|なが}してしまった。
examples.english: The tide of the times has swept away old values.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: {押|お}す (to push) + {流|なが}す (to let flow) = to push and let flow away

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Takes を to mark what is being washed/swept away. Often used in passive form {押|お}し{流|なが}される.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{洪水|こうずい}に{押|お}し{流|なが}される (to be washed away by a flood)
・{津波|つなみ}に{押|お}し{流|なが}される (to be swept away by a tsunami)
・{濁流|だくりゅう}に{押|お}し{流|なが}される (to be swept away by muddy torrents)

USAGE NOTE: Very commonly used in disaster news reporting. The passive form {押|お}し{流|なが}される is particularly frequent.

RELATED ～{流|なが}す COMPOUND VERBS:
・{流|なが}し{込|こ}む - to pour into
・{洗|あら}い{流|なが}す - to wash away
・{吹|ふ}き{流|なが}す - to blow away
